heroHeadline: 11 Ships Attacked in Hormuz Since October; Tanker Freight Costs Exceed SpaceX Rocket Launch Price
heroSubtitle: At least 11 commercial vessels have been struck in and around the Strait of Hormuz since early October; tanker freight rates have surged to levels surpassing a SpaceX rocket launch, forcing rerouting around the Cape of Good Hope
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports (FAO, World Bank, IMF, IEA, WFP), major outlets (Reuters, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, CNBC), and institutional analyses (Lloyd's List, S&P Global, IFPRI, Atlantic Council).
